card.description: A towering basalt obelisk, 30 m tall, tapering to a pointed apex, etched with intricate Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs that glow with bioluminescent veins. Embedded crystalline cores pulse with azure light, surrounded by a lattice of metal alloy plating. The scene is set in a dimly lit subterranean chamber, with dust motes floating in shafts of filtered light, emphasizing tactile realism and industrial mysticism.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Monolithic basalt structure, 30 m tall, tapered to a pointed apex, textured with weathered stone and fine fissures.
**Face/Sensors:** Panels of etched glyphs serve as sensor arrays; bioluminescent veins trace the glyphs, pulsing in sync with the crystalline core.
**Key Features:** Embedded crystalline cores emitting azure light, metal alloy lattice plating, intricate runic glyphs, dust-laden interior chamber, tactile stone texture, bioluminescent glow.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Activation): Obelisk dormant, glyphs faint, crystalline cores dim.
Phase 2 (Full Activation): Glyphs glow intensely, crystalline cores pulse, energy flows through bioluminescent veins.
props: Item: Runic Key – a bronze key with matching glyphs, worn and etched.
Item: Ancient Scroll – parchment with faded hieroglyphs, partially unrolled.
